jobs.description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. We want a leader who understands the accounting impact of every transaction and builds controls to get the data right at the source. Dandy runs high-volume physical operations: two US manufacturing labs, dental practice and DSO customers in several countries, a large vendor base and multiple legal entities. jobs.description: Unternehmen Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH ist Teil der PolymerCycle Gruppe und spezialisiert auf die Regranulierung und das Recompounding technischer Kunststoffe. Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH liefert ihre Produkte an höchst anspruchsvolle Kundenindustrien – wie die Automobilbranche, Elektro-/Elektronik oder Haushaltsgeräte – zuverlässig und nach strengen Qualitätsanforderungen. Dafür greift die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH auf langjährige Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung und Compoundierung von technischen Kunststoffen zurück. Mit einem vollumfänglichen, modern ausgestatteten Labor bietet Hoffmann+Voss umfassende Analytik-, Prüf- und Entwicklungsleistungen. In der Gruppe bündeln die Unternehmen der PolymerCycle Gruppe ihren Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Rohstoffströmen, ihre Expertise in komplexen Kundenindustrien, umfangreiche Produktionskapazitäten sowie tiefes technologisches und materialwissenschaftliches Know-how. Durch die Kombination von Sortier-, Trenn-, Regranulierungs- und Compounding-Know-how entstehen hochwertige Recyclinglösungen, die sowohl technische Anforderungen erfüllen als auch die wachsende europäische Nachfrage nach qualitätsgesicherten Rezyklaten bedienen. Für das Werk der Hoffmann+Voss GmbH in Viersen suchen wir einen Leiter Operations (m/w/d).
